item.description: A Vietnam-sponsored hacking group has been attributed to attacks targeting Southeast Asian military, government, and legislative organizations with an aim to gather intelligence on South China Sea defense and military agreements. The previously undocumented incursion set, detailed by SOCRadar, has been codenamed WeaveLotus. The activity is assessed to have comprised five intrusions in Thailand
